object_label: Inscribed bronze double axe from Arkalochori

claims.claim: Museum presents the bronze inscription as Hieroglyphic.
Script cannot be securely assigned to Cretan Hieroglyphic or Linear A; comparison with the Disc is discussed.
The small gold and silver axes with Linear A inscriptions are separate objects from the bronze axe.

source_leads.author: Georgia Flouda
source_leads.title: Materiality and script: constructing a narrative on the Minoan inscribed axe from the Arkalochori cave
source_leads.redistribution: Bibliographic reference and project paraphrase only; no PDF or drawings imported

comparison_policy: Keep proposed sign correspondences as attributed hypotheses. Do not pool with Cretan Hieroglyphic, Linear A or Disc occurrences.
